headline: 'Nikkei to Reach 75,000 by Year-End'... Forecasts Raised Across the Board for Japanese Stocks Led by Domestic-Demand Shares
summary: Forecasts for the Nikkei 225 to reach 75,000 by year-end are spreading, supported by improving earnings at Japanese companies. Retail and food stocks could benefit if yen weakness eases.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index of 225 major companies, widely used by global investors to gauge the Japanese equity market.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: Analyst forecasts for the index to reach 75,000 by year-end point to expected gains in the benchmark.
